observations.why: Directive issued as a standing order — the speaker enacts authority by unilaterally setting a recurring cadence the organization must follow.

The 'we' enacts communal-sharing — the team as an undifferentiated body that either holds a capability or does not — while the conditional framing ('a rollback we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have') asserts authority over what counts as real capability, collapsing rehearsal into possession.

mints.name: StandingOrderFromAuthority
mints.title: run monthly from now on
mints.frame: Is the speaker unilaterally setting a recurring obligation the organization must follow, enacting authority through a standing order rather than a one-time request?
